---
name: Refactor Request
about: Request improvements to existing code without changing behavior
labels: refactor
---

## Description
Provide a clear description of what part of the code needs to be refactored and why.

## Motivation
Why is this refactor important?  
(e.g., simplify logic, improve maintainability, reduce complexity, prepare for new features)

## Current behavior
Describe how the code currently works and what the limitations are.

## Proposed refactor
Explain the approach you suggest or ask for guidance if you're unsure.

## Additional context
Add any notes, links, diagrams, or considerations that might be useful.
